_🩺 Stability & Availability_ | _🟠 Major_ | _⚡ Quick win_

**Set a deadline for the history worker.**

If the worker stalls during an SDK history operation, `child.exitCode` and the stream drains can wait indefinitely. The 1 MiB limits cap retained output, not execution time. Apply a timeout to the scoped fork operation so a stalled worker releases the fork request and its child process.
